shared_elements: horizontal band filled with repeated short vertical strokes
row of repeated small upright figures along a horizontal line
curved hook-like or beaked terminal forms
monochrome earth-toned surface with no colour contrast between motif and ground
justification: The most specific correspondence is the repeated rank of small upright strokes/figures aligned along a horizontal band, which in A forms the crew of the vessels and in B forms a hatched register beneath the upper row of motifs, giving both a banded, register-like organisation. Otherwise the works differ fundamentally: A is a flat, painted linear outline of two vessels on natural rock, while B is a three-dimensional carved relief of distinct zoomorphic bodies in profile with modelled volume, so the shared features are generic rather than compositional.
